form.label: ANL - Pivot File
form.description: Dashboard to search for files across Zeek and host data using hash, filename, file path, and file size. Includes information about the hosts where the file appeared, last execution time, executing user, and date first seen.

search.query: index=network sourcetype="zeek:files" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search total_bytes="$file_size_token$" OR seen_bytes="$file_size_token$" | stats count
index=host sourcetype="wmi:file" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" | search size="$file_size_token$" | stats count
index=host sourcetype="wmi:process" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" | stats count

(index=network sourcetype="zeek:files" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:file" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:process") | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" OR md5="$file_hash_token$" OR sha1="$file_hash_token$" OR sha256="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" OR extracted="$file_path_token$" | eval host=coalesce(hostname, id_orig_h, id_resp_h) | stats dc(host) as unique_hosts

index=network sourcetype="zeek:files" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search total_bytes="$file_size_token$" OR seen_bytes="$file_size_token$" | eval file_size_kb=round(coalesce(total_bytes, seen_bytes)/1024, 2) | eval duration_sec=round(duration, 3) | table filename, mime_type, file_size_kb, seen_bytes, total_bytes, _time, id_orig_h, id_resp_h, duration_sec, extracted_source, fuid | sort -_time

index=host sourcetype="wmi:file" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" | search size="$file_size_token$" | eval file_size_kb=round(size/1024, 2) | eval full_path=path + "\\" + filename | table filename, full_path, file_size_kb, hash, hostname, created_time, modified_time, accessed_time | sort -_time

index=host sourcetype="wmi:process" | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" | eval full_path=path + "\\" + filename | table _time, hostname, filename, full_path, hash, user, parent_process, command_line, last_executed_time | sort -_time

(index=network sourcetype="zeek:files" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:file" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:process") | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" | eval file_hash=hash | eval host=coalesce(hostname, id_orig_h, id_resp_h) | eval data_source=case( sourcetype="zeek:files", "Network Transfer", sourcetype="wmi:file", "File System", sourcetype="wmi:process", "Process Execution", 1==1, "Other") | stats count as occurrences, dc(host) as unique_hosts, values(host) as affected_hosts, values(data_source) as data_sources, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen, values(filename) as filenames by file_hash | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -occurrences

(index=network sourcetype="zeek:files" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:file" OR index=host sourcetype="wmi:process") | search filename="$file_name_token$" | search hash="$file_hash_token$" OR md5="$file_hash_token$" OR sha1="$file_hash_token$" OR sha256="$file_hash_token$" | search path="$file_path_token$" OR extracted="$file_path_token$" | eval host=coalesce(hostname, id_orig_h, id_resp_h) | eval data_source=case( sourcetype="zeek:files", "Network", sourcetype="wmi:file", "FileSystem", sourcetype="wmi:process", "Process", 1==1, "Other") | stats count as total_events, dc(filename) as unique_files, values(data_source) as event_types, earliest(_time) as first_activity, latest(_time) as last_activity by host | eval first_activity=strftime(first_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_activity=strftime(last_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -total_events
